This was the first manned space rendezvous and docking implemented by China. <image1> During the in-orbit operation of the “Tiangong-1” and “Shenzhou-9” combination, the celestial body system formed by it and the celestial body it orbits belongs to the same level as which celestial body system?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the image, a combination formed by two docked spacecraft can be seen, and below in the background is the curved surface of the Earth and cloud layers, indicating that this combination is orbiting above the Earth. Then reason: The question asks about “the celestial body system formed by it and the celestial body it orbits.” The image and the question together show that the celestial body orbited by the “Tiangong-1” and “Shenzhou-9” combination is the Earth; this combination is equivalent to an artificial satellite of the Earth, so what it forms with the Earth is a celestial body system at the “Earth—satellite” level. The natural celestial body system at the same level as this kind of “planet and its satellite” is the Earth-Moon system formed by the Earth and the Moon.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：画面显示对接后的航天器在地球上空运行。再结合题干问“其与所绕转的天体构成的天体系统”，把所绕转的天体确定为地球；“天宫一号—神舟九号组合体”相当于地球的一颗人造卫星，因此它与地球构成的是地球—卫星系统。与之同级的自然天体系统是地球和月球组成的地月系。

<image1>

“天宫一号”与“神舟九号”组合体在轨运行期间,其与所绕转的天体构成的天体系统与哪个天体系统属于同一级别?

The natural celestial body system at the same level as this kind of “planet and its satellite” is the Earth-Moon system formed by the Earth and the Moon.
